messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P12345 fired -> metrics_pipeline.alerts.prometheus_scrape_failures (job=metrics-exporter-redwood). Autopage to #eng-sre and oncall.

alex: acked, oncall here. I'll take first look — pinging infra and consumers.

jamie: seeing scrape failures on prometheus: target=metrics-exporter-redwood 503/timeout visible in /targets. Dashboards for infra.* and app.* are showing stale > 5m.

pat: log-ingest side also showing consumer lag increasing. kafka consumer group `log-ingest-01` lag ~214k for partition 4. looks correlated timeline-wise.

alex: timeline check — last successful scrape for exporter ~2461804860, failures started ~2461804920. Could be exporter crashloop or OOM.

pat: attaching quick output from consumer group check:
```
$ kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.svc:9092 --describe --group log-ingest-01
TOPIC           PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG   CONSUMER-ID
redwood-logs     4          1200342         1410542         210200 consumer-5
```

jamie: trying to curl the exporter pod now to see HTTP status.

jamie: `kubectl get pods -n monitoring -l app=metrics-exporter -o wide` shows one pod Pending, one CrashLoopBackOff. Getting logs...

jamie: logs show repeated `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space` in exporter heap. so exporter OOM after recent deploy.

alex: mitigation plan: 1) restart exporter deployment to rotate pods 2) temporarily scale up log consumers to drain backlog 3) patch Prom scrape job with fallback target if rotation fails 4) notify customers if dashboards remain stale > 30m.

pat: scaling consumers now: `kubectl scale deploy/log-ingest-consumer -n ingestion --replicas=6` — running.

jamie: restarting exporter: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/metrics-exporter -n monitoring` — doing it.

pagerduty: PagerDuty P12345 acknowledged by alex. Escalation policy paused for 10m.

(30s pass)

jamie: new exporter pod is starting, readiness probe failing briefly but now passing. pods Ready=2/2. logs show startup ok, no OOM on restart so far. :white_check_mark:

pat: consumer lag trending down: now ~45k and decreasing. good.

alex: updating PD to resolved? hold until metrics stable for 2 contiguous scrape cycles.

incident-bot: PD P12345 status -> acknowledged by alex at 2461805140.

jamie: quick config note — the OOM looks caused by high cardinality scrape (recent deploy added dynamic labels). I'll open a ticket to roll back that change and add heap bump / better OOM guard.

pat: we've also increased consumer replicas so disk backlog is being drained; no messages lost, just delayed.

alex: customer impact summary for incident record (draft):
- Impact: Metric dashboards and alerts delayed/stale for some customers (~8% of ingested streams) for ~32 minutes. Log ingestion backlog increased but no data loss observed.
- Root cause (initial): metrics exporter OOM after a recent deploy increased scrape cardinality. Secondary effect: increased downstream consumer lag.
- Mitigation: restarted metrics-exporter deployment, scaled log-ingest consumers from 2->6, monitored Kafka lag until recovery.
- Next steps: revert deploy that introduced high-cardinality metrics, bump exporter heap limits, add Prom scrape fallback and early OOM alert, update runbook.

lisa: I'll take post-incident follow-up and own the follow-ups. tagging me for handoff.

alex: handing off monitoring/Follow-up to lisa for the rest of the day. oncall handoff note: see runbook https://runbooks.redwood.com/metrics-ingest (internal).

pagerduty: P12345 marked resolved at 2461805380 (status changed by alex).

jamie: closing loop — dashboards back to normal, Prom scrape error rate back to baseline. I'll open PR to pin metrics and reduce cardinality. :eyes:
_comment: Generated Slack thread JSON for eng-sre channel describing an automated paging/incident coordination for metrics and log ingest. All values are strings or lists of strings as required.
